title: Forensic-grade event correlation + SSO signal enrichment for RBAC v2 remediation
creator: Leah Park
description: Background: Recent pentest findings called out gaps in how SSO/SAML assertions, admin session transitions, and RBAC v2 decision events are logged and correlated. Current audit events are siloed across the auth service, console, and runtime tracer, making post-incident forensics slow and brittle. Goal: Produce a small, high-impact remediation that (1) adds enriched SSO/RBAC decision context to audit events, (2) implements a deterministic correlation key across services for admin sessions, and (3) closes the highest-risk pen-test findings with fixes + tests.
acceptance_criteria: Audit events for SSO assertions include: assertion id, subject id, relying party, authn method, assertion validity window, and redaction-safe claim subset
RBAC v2 decision events include policy_version, principal_roles, resource_scope, decision_reason, and consistent event id correlated to SSO assertion when present
Deterministic session correlation key generated at auth time and propagated in headers/tracing spans across console, control-plane, and runtime
Automated end-to-end test (integration) validates that a simulated admin escalate flow produces a correlated event chain in the audit index
Pen-test high findings referenced in the report are marked Closed or Mitigated with remediation notes
Design doc and security review memo posted to Confluence and linked in ticket, and changes reviewed by Security and SRE
No PII or secrets leaked in enriched events; sample payloads passed through the data classification filter and approved by Security
tasks: Threat model update: enumerate attack surfaces for cross-service session replay and forged assertion correlation - owner: Nina Patel - due 2025-02-22
Design: propose schema for enriched audit events and correlation key format (stable, HMAC-protected, short) - owner: Mateo Rivera - due 2025-02-26
Implementation: auth-service produce correlation_key and attach to SAML session + metrics - owner: Mateo Rivera - PR #4872
Runtime: accept correlation header and annotate KV-cache logs and token-use traces - owner: Rajesh Iyer - PR #4890
Console: attach correlation_key to admin actions and forwards to audit pipeline - owner: Sofia Alvarez - PR #4905
Audit pipeline: ingest new schema, add enrichment mapping, add schema validation and retention rules - owner: DataInfra - PR #4918
E2E test: simulate login -> escalate -> revoke and assert correlated events in Elasticsearch/dashboards - owner: QA - ticket QA-122
Pen-test closure: write remediation notes mapping changes to each pen-test finding and request re-verification - owner: Security - due 2025-03-05
comments: 2025-02-18 Leah Park: Created ticket after post-pen-test debrief. Initial priority set to P0 due to customer-impacting admin-path findings.

2025-02-20 Nina Patel: Completed threat model update; main risks: (1) correlation key predictability, (2) log amplification leaking claims. Recommendation: HMAC the key with a short rotating salt and keep claim subset minimal.

2025-02-24 Mateo Rivera: Design doc v1 uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/RBACv2-Event-Correlation. Key format proposal: base64(hmac_sha256(auth_session_id || timestamp)[:16]). Feedback wanted on rotation interval.

2025-02-26 Security Review (Raj Gupta): Reviewed design; asked for explicit replays and abuse scenarios. Approved HMAC approach if rotation <= 24h and salt rotated via KMS. Marked security_review_required=true.
2025-03-03 Rajesh Iyer: Runtime changes merged to staging (PR #4890). Note: had to extend trace context propagation; adding feature flag runtime.correlation_propagation=false for controlled rollout.

2025-03-06 Sofia Alvarez: Console patch for annotating admin actions awaiting integration tests. Found edge-case where unauthenticated service calls omitted correlation header; added guard and fallback generation by control-plane.

2025-03-09 QA: E2E smoke passes locally; observed a mismatch in timestamp normalization causing two correlation keys for same session when drift >2s. Suggested normalizing to auth-server-issued epoch.

2025-03-11 Security (Lina Chen): Pen-test report mapping attached. Two high findings now marked Mitigated, one medium moved to backlog for longer-term detection rules. Requested re-run from pentest vendor after 2025-03-14.
2025-03-12 Mateo Rivera: Updated ticket with remediation docs, test links, and final checklist. Requesting sign-off from SRE and Security to schedule canary rollout next week.
